intent: Repair the clean-main X-Ray discovery defect routed by issue #1057: discover_files() in dharma_swarm/xray.py applies the MAX_FILES=2000 traversal cap mid-walk, so which files survive depends on os.walk/scandir order (filesystem-dependent). On checkouts where tests/ is traversed late, analyze_repo() reports test_file_count == 1 against the contract test_file_count > 20 (tests/test_xray.py::TestRunXray::test_on_dharma_swarm). Fix: walk the full tree deterministically (sorted dirs and filenames), and when the matched set exceeds MAX_FILES, cap by deterministic per-top-level-directory proportional allocation so no top-level directory (including tests/) is silently starved. Adds a deterministic failing-first regression test that reproduces the starvation without depending on traversal order, plus a negative control asserting under-cap discovery is unchanged. No test deselection, no timeout change, no WP-0D or Mike-owned surface touched.
